confidence_notes: FX came from an RBA search result: 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. I did not open the RBA page myself. Food and drink anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living sources (Livingcost, Traveltables, Expatistan, Whereandwhen). Some of those sources are dated or crowdsourced, and they vary a lot. Beer is a pub 0.5L price of about €4.2–4.8. Cocktail and wine are based on a nightlife guide (cocktails €7–9, wine €4–7) and on typical ratios to beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for July peak-season demand. I did not search for accommodation or check any listings, so they are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Palermo is a mid-sized southern Italian tourist city, cheaper than Rome, Florence or Venice. Its prices are close to Naples and Catania, with somewhat higher accommodation in summer.
